plain: A video of a UAP, the government's term for a UFO, being hit by a Hellfire missile, a US air-to-surface missile, is said to have been shown before the US Congress in 2025. Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for intercepted signals, hired him to talk with aliens, mentions it in passing as something a man named Eric Brent was talking about. If true, it would mean the US military has fired on one of these objects and shown lawmakers the footage.
